protocol: Paired same-machine/model/corpus HTTP latency check, two ordered rounds. First round can include cold path/model caches; round 2 is repeat-query state. No concurrent refresh/profile/test load. Do not interpret 12 observations as population latency or accuracy. Each answer must retain its actual conditions and source.
